request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only colours and materials: the red rocket tube becomes mismatched rusted iron and dark gunmetal scrap plates with bolts and one wide band of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes; the fuse spark red-orange; the cart becomes weathered dark brown planks with rusty iron wheels; the goblin wears near-black brown leather. Keep the cream cone, stick, fuse, the rocket and cart shapes, the crouching goblin, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
